name: adv_junction_fluid_mixer_enthalpy
source:
// The library Mixer flow-weights the outlet enthalpy: 1 kg/s @ 100 kJ/kg with
// 3 kg/s @ 400 kJ/kg must give 325 kJ/kg, not 250.
COMPONENT FluidBoundary(out)
  PARAM P, h, mdot
  out.P    = P
  out.h    = h
  out.mdot = mdot
END
FluidBoundary SRC1(f1, P = 300000, h = 100000, mdot = 1.0)
FluidBoundary SRC2(f2, P = 300000, h = 400000, mdot = 3.0)
Mixer         MX(f1, f2, f3)
Sink          SK(f3)
h1 = f1.h
h2 = f2.h
h3 = f3.h
m3 = f3.mdot
